evidence.reason: INTERACTION has actions (54 checkboxes, Copy, Exportar relatório, Reiniciar) but no post-click state was captured: all checkboxes are unchecked and no toast, checked state or updated counter is shown, so immediate feedback cannot be verified.
All content is static pages; the only operations are clipboard copy, a markdown export and a .zip download, none long enough to need a designed loading state.

There is no data-entry form: the INSTALL command field is a read-only display beside a Copy button and the checklist is only checkboxes, so inline validation does not apply (no form-submit-empty capture exists).

'Reiniciar' in the progress card is destructive (clears saved progress) but no capture shows what happens after clicking it, so the presence of a confirmation or undo cannot be verified from the screenshots.

ENTRY's first screen states what the site is in one line and puts the 'Explorar skills' CTA and the first project cards inside the 1440×900 fold; INTERACTION's first screen already shows the install command, the progress card and the first checklist section, so the core content is reached without extra steps.

The fresh zero-progress state ('0/54 itens · 0%') is explained in place — 'O progresso fica salvo neste navegador. Exportar copia um relatório em markdown.' — and the page lead tells the user the next step ('marque item a item aqui no navegador'), with the checklist starting directly below.

Help appears at the point of use rather than as a tour: every checklist item carries a one-line explanation under its title and each section ends with a 'ref:' pointer, the progress card has an inline note about saving/exporting, and DISCOVERY tells the user 'Abra uma skill para o comando de install ou o download' right above the cards.
The 54-item audit checklist shows position and remaining work: an overall '0/54 itens · 0%' counter with a progress bar plus per-category counters (0/5, 0/7, 0/9…) each with their own bar.
No testimonials or quotes appear on any of the four surfaces.
No numbers are used as proof; the only figures visible are the checklist counters (0/54), the version string v3.6.0 and the © 2026 footer.

The adoption decision point is the INSTALL box ('npx skills add …', Copy, 'Download .zip') on DETAIL and INTERACTION, and no social proof sits next to it — no stars, user counts, logos or ratings; the only trust text is 'Licença MIT' at the very bottom and 'Inspirado pela comunidade…' in DISCOVERY's footer.
